notes: The page says students under 18 must get a work permit. Teens must also join at least one year-round track.
name: RYSE MED (Readying Youth Scientists for Excellence in Medicine)
what_you_do: For 6 weeks, shadow health care workers, do hands-on and virtual reality practice, and give a group talk on a health topic. Then join monthly meetings from September to May.
who_can_apply: First-time participants who go to high school or live in metro Detroit, in 10th or 11th grade, age 16 or older by program start, GPA 2.5 or higher, and allowed to work in the U.S.
pay_detail: The page says stipends or wages may be available for high school students but are not guaranteed. The program is free.
duration: 6 weeks (2026: June 28 to Aug 7, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.) plus monthly meetings September to May
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-27 group are closed. Details for the 2027-28 group come 'in the new year.'
how_to_apply: The page does not describe the steps. Email HAPE@hfhs.org with questions.
